name: Хлёсткий боковой

A single non-looping attack: brief wind-up, ONE fast strike with a short sharp forward weight shift, crisp impact pose, then immediate low-blade recovery to the starting stance. Never swing again during recovery; no combo, second attack or repeated cycle. At contact show one broad ivory-white crescent with a warm pale-gold inner edge, following the sword path, then promptly fading. One sword only.
